name: What's the difference between satin and semi-gloss paint for trim?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between satin and semi-gloss paint for trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Satin and semi-gloss are both popular choices for interior trim, differing primarily in their sheen level and durability. Satin offers a softer, subtle sheen that's easy to clean but can show minor imperfections. Semi-gloss provides a noticeable shine, reflects more light, and is highly durable and very easy to wipe clean, making it excellent for high-traffic areas. The choice often comes down to aesthetic preference and the level of durability needed for your specific trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Satin paint has a softer sheen and is easier to clean, while semi-gloss has a noticeable shine, is more durable, and very easy to clean.
